whatHappened: The plaintiff asked the court to stop Defendant No. 1 from doing more work on the disputed property. The court agreed to this for now. Defendant No. 1 must not build more, sell the property, or interfere with it while the main case is going on.
plainSummary: The plaintiff asked the court to stop Defendant No. 1 from doing more work on the disputed property. The court agreed to this for now. Defendant No. 1 must not build more, sell the property, or interfere with it while the main case is going on.
whatYouNeedToDo: Plaintiff: Give the court the required undertaking about possible damages.
Defendant No. 1: Do not build anything more on the disputed property.
Defendant No. 1: Do not sell or otherwise transfer the property or interfere with it.
The main case is to continue in court.

keyDates.event: The case was listed for the next step, called 'framing of issues.'

whereThisStands: The court has temporarily stopped Defendant No. 1 from taking certain actions on the property. The main case is still going on, and the court has not yet decided who owns the property or whether there was an encroachment.

changes: Interim injunction granted restraining Defendant No. 1 from further construction or alienation.
Plaintiff directed to file necessary undertaking regarding potential damages.
Case posted for framing of issues on 30 May 2026.
